evidence.title: SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction

summary: Researchers introduced SAGE, a stability-aware graph-based ensemble method for feature selection, enhancing explainability in predicting postpartum depression risk. The approach aims to provide more reliable and interpretable insights for clinical decision-making.
title: New AI Model SAGE Improves Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction with Explainable Feature Selection
